claim: Local automated production battle-command/session/model acceptance with real SQL and captured session transport; disposable setup is separate.
scope: one authoritative manual battle-item capability policy
reject unsupported commands/choices/legacy queue before declaration or reservation
discard unsupported restored/deferred declaration/pending/PositionData views before readiness
engine pre-turn validation before counters/conditions and final dispatch guard
preserve supported medicines, reserve/move targets, wild capture and Smoke Ball held/flee route
help, support notes, player-flow tests and lifecycle CI
supported_policy: BattleMedicineUse.supports plus actual isPokeball capture metadata; capture remains wild-only. Smoke Ball redirects to +hold/+flee.
no_effect_policy: An otherwise supported medicine can queue and spend a turn when it has no effect; no inventory is consumed. Unsupported manual items are rejected before queuing or spending an action.
source_hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 normalized LF text; checked against staged and committed blobs before publication.

walkthroughs.label: unsupported-before-capture
